data.title: New AI tool for voters offers a specialized chatbot to explain your ballot
data.description: Many people are increasingly turning to AI chatbots for information on candidates, ballot measures and even polling locations ahead of the midterm elections. NBC News AI reporter Jared Perlo joins "Here's the Scoop" to explain how a new, nonpartisan AI-powered app, VoteMate, is hoping to help voters and stop the spread of election misinformation.
